source: Iced-Cream's own test on their unit: elkbench plans KBH F1, T1 and F2 (runs r-bf3d20, r-05d8db, r-0ef22c), gated in the emulator on the same PC
statement: On an Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74 and this package on Modwerk's base (core-ar2 0.7, plain variant ba530f45, with analoghealth 1.2 for remote keys), build KBH7, 2026-11-08: KIT menu RELOAD twice on an unedited kit: KIT RELOADED! both times, saved BD DEC kept (screen). BD DEC turned to 0; RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! with the saved DEC; RELOAD again: EDITS RESTORED! with DEC at 0 (screens). After RELOAD armed the A/B, DEC turned to 127; RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! (not EDITS RESTORED!) with the saved DEC; RELOAD again: EDITS RESTORED! with DEC at 127, not the stashed 0 (screens). CPU 76.6 / 76.2 %, DSP 70.1 / 70.0 %, heap flat, two readings 30 s apart after the flash. The run stopped before its last section (a change of kit) on a kit-list reference mismatch; NO + PLAY was not exercised.
scope: kit-ab 1.0.0 on Modwerk's base (KBH7), through the KIT menu's RELOAD. Not covered: NO + PLAY, a change of kit, persistence.

builds.label: KBH7
builds.content: Stock OS 1.74 + Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant ba530f45) + analoghealth 1.2 (remote keys, test harness; no site shared with this module) + kit-ab 1.0.0, linked by scripts/link-image.mjs. Driven by elkbench plans after their emulator gate; stock 1.74 restored at the end.
results: KIT menu RELOAD twice on an unedited kit: KIT RELOADED! both times, saved BD DEC kept (screen).
BD DEC turned to 0; RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! with the saved DEC; RELOAD again: EDITS RESTORED! with DEC at 0 (screens).
After RELOAD armed the A/B, DEC turned to 127; RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! (not EDITS RESTORED!) with the saved DEC; RELOAD again: EDITS RESTORED! with DEC at 127, not the stashed 0 (screens).
CPU 76.6 / 76.2 %, DSP 70.1 / 70.0 %, heap flat, two readings 30 s apart after the flash.
notRun: A change of kit (KIT menu LOAD KIT to kit 2) was not reached: the run stopped at the kit list, whose reference (recorded in the emulator) lacks a marker the unit draws after kits 02-16. The check compared list content the plan does not control; the module had not acted yet.

NO + PLAY was not exercised: remote NO(PLAY) starts the sequencer in the emulator. The KIT menu's RELOAD calls the same kit_ab_toggle; the two NO + PLAY sites (0x400cd51a, 0x400cd542) are untested on the unit.
A press on a kit with no edits after an A/B, and a power cycle (the stash is not kept, by design), were not run.

individualTestResults: Unedited kit: two RELOADs are plain reloads
Edit, RELOAD, RELOAD: KIT RELOADED! then EDITS RESTORED!
An edit while the saved kit plays ends the A/B
Change of kit: not reached (kit-list reference mismatch)

contextNote: Main OS hash is the build's, not read back from the device. The plan's T1 run is recorded as failed (its last section); the results above are its sections that passed.
